name: ht-company-tax-and-advances
description: Haiti company-tax reference under the replacement Tax Code effective 1 October 2026. Covers taxable entity classification, effective-management residence, the ordinary profit-tax rate, the savings-and-credit cooperative exception, annual financial statements, the audit threshold and provisional payments. Gives mechanical calculations using an already reconciled taxable profit and the correct historical advance-payment base. Separates company returns from individual business returns and identifies special-sector and transition cases requiring further source work. Does not establish a complete taxable-profit reconciliation, treaty treatment, operational forms or accountant attestation.
